room_backgrounds.creation_method: OpenAI image generation with project-owned geometry references

human_author_contribution: Art direction, prompts, geometry constraints, asset selection, sprite cleanup, layout authorship, collision tuning, variant review and runtime composition; requires formal documentation review.
